credential-id.description: Identifier of the issued credential, for example an AWS Access Key ID or GCP service account key ID; exclude the secret key value.

last-used.description: Last observed use in ISO 8601; convert source epoch milliseconds when necessary.

type.description: Credential category, for example API Key, Service Account Key, or Client Certificate.

description: A service credential identifier and its observed usage, for API key and service account investigations. Record credential metadata rather than secret values. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/programmatic_credential.
name: programmatic-credential
